text:
Cheryl Gourlay (Strategic Partnership Manager | NatWest Accelerator)
So many women have brilliant business ideas, but taking that first step can often feel like the hardest part.

That’s why I’m so excited to share Begin a free 6-week programme from Digital Boost  and BUY WOMEN BUILT, designed to help women turn ideas into action.

Through my work with founders and involvement in the NatWest Accelerator community, I’ve seen how much difference the right support, guidance and network can make when you’re starting out. Confidence often comes from having the right people around you.

Begin offers exactly that  structure, encouragement and practical support to help you move forward, whether you’re exploring an idea or building something new.


💡 What you’ll get:
• A flexible online programme you can fit around work, family and life
• Step-by-step guidance to shape your idea
• Inspiration from founders in the Buy Women Built community
• Support from peers and mentors on the same journey


Starting a business doesn’t mean having all the answers. Just the willingness to begin.


🚀 Applications close Monday 15 June


👉 digitalboost.org.uk/begin

I’m really proud to see NatWest supporting programmes like this through the NatWest Accelerator, helping more women access the tools, community and confidence to get started.

Maybe this is your sign to begin.

#FemaleFounders #WomenInBusiness #Entrepreneurship #StartUp #NatWestAccelerator #SheBegins #JustBegin

So excited to be partnering with you on this! 🙌
Cheryl Gourlay — Strategic Partnership Manager | NatWest Accelerator — NatWest Business — United Kingdom, United Kingdom
